about: What a link in a reply opens inside the app (docs/protocol.md, "Links into the thread"): work:<words> a step of the turn's working, thread:<id> another thread, review:<id> a design review, button:<id> a reply button; anything else (a web page) is null here. The scheme in any case; the rest percent-decoded and trimmed. expect is null or {kind, value}. The desktop app (desktop/core/src/reply_links.rs thread_link), the iPhone (ThreadLinks.target), Android (ThreadLinks.target) and the website (web/src/thread-links.ts readLink)..

cases.name: a work link quotes a step

expect.value: Commit, land, retire the old shared simulator

cases.name: a quote can have brackets in it
a thread link names its thread
a review link names its review
a button link names its button
the scheme is read in any case
a web page isn't a link into the thread
an empty button link is no link
an empty thread link is no link

differs.desktop: Follows it with the words as they are (desktop/core/src/reply_links.rs thread_link), so the click says it found nothing, rather than reading it as no link.

cases.name: an empty work link is no link

differs.desktop: Follows it with the words as they are (desktop/core/src/reply_links.rs thread_link), so the click says it found nothing, rather than reading it as no link.

cases.name: an empty review link is no link

differs.desktop: Follows it with the words as they are (desktop/core/src/reply_links.rs thread_link), so the click says it found nothing, rather than reading it as no link.

cases.name: spaces round a thread's id are trimmed

differs.desktop: Keeps the spaces, so the thread isn't found.

cases.name: an escape that isn't UTF-8 stays as written

differs.desktop: Decodes it leniently, to U+FFFD, so it quotes a step no line has either way.
